title: Sammy Face Mod
description: This mod adds a new dimension called Sammy Face Dimension with its own biome, to enter the Sammy Face Dimension you will need to make a 4x5 portal with Sammy Face Portal Block then light it with Sammy Face Portal Ignighter.
body: This is a mod that adds a dimension called Sammy Face Dimension. It adds a new portal which you use to go to Sammy Face Dimension. It uses a 4x5 portal made by using the Sammy Face Portal Block and an item called Sammy Face Portal Ignigher that after you made the frame and you right-click a block on the frame it will light and if you go through it you will get the Sammy DImension which looks kinda brown and blue water from the gallery.
